sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Simple sequencing expressions such as *reggel*, délben, délután and *este* help organise a routine.

items.english: I get up in the morning.
I go to bed in the evening.

sections.content: felkelek and lefekszem are mirror images by design: fel- means ‘up’ and le- means ‘down,’ glued onto kelek (‘I rise’) and fekszem (‘I lie’). Once you notice that prefix pattern, a whole family of up/down, in/out verb pairs starts to feel predictable instead of arbitrary.
